label: flash-vague-final-consistency-20261005-10
scope: Independent reading of selected exact counterexamples in the frozen latest candidate. Not a complete final artifact review or target execution.

findings.reason: Import accepts only File. Validation returns no preview database revision/generation or byte identity. The promised re-preview after another tab writes cannot be expressed in the public contract.

Foundation acceptance invokes listExpiredTrashedNotes(), which the latest IStorageService does not declare. Use an existing listNotes plus the documented expiry predicate or define one coherent public method everywhere.

SessionDraft is a structured, versioned object, but quick-capture acceptance specifies directly storing content text. Producer, getDraft(), restore validation, and draft file export need the same shape.

Backup duplicates tracker metadata inside an open-ended AppMeta[] and a separate backupTracker; it does not close duplicate-key consistency, library generation handling, imported tracker/reminder policy, or complete per-field validation.

The normative tag rule normalizes case, while quick-capture acceptance expects Dexie after entering #Dexie. Also specify editable-focus and IME guards for N so typing ordinary n never steals the cursor.
